title: Data and R code for: Oxygen isotopes in phosphate (δ18OP) reveal functional separation between labile and stable legacy phosphorus in soil
description:
Data and R code for the article Oxygen isotopes in phosphate (δ18OP) reveal functional separation between labile and stable legacy phosphorus in soil by Arfania, Kayler, Strawn, Brooks, Feber and Laan (Biogeochemistry).

The archive contains the oxygen isotope composition of phosphate (δ18OP) and the phosphorus concentration of four sequentially extracted (Hedley) fractions in 12 composite soil samples from the R. J. Cook Agronomy Farm (Pullman, Washington, USA), sampled at top-slope and toe-slope positions under conventional tillage and no-till on three winter dates; the δ18O and δ2H of the soil water of each sample and of 22 precipitation samples; the soil temperature measured at sampling; and the daily record of the Pullman 2 NW weather station for 2023 and 2024.

The R scripts calculate the equilibrium values and the departure from equilibrium of every observation and reproduce Tables 1 and 2, Supplementary Tables S1 to S3, the statistics quoted in Sections 3.1 to 3.5 and in Supplementary Texts S1 and S2, and Figures 2 to 5, S1 and S2 of the article. Running run_all.R also writes a table that compares each quoted value with the script output.
